skills.name: Invasion
skills.summary: Lv1: ■ Activates when the last round of ammunition hits while the skill user is in the Collect Hacking Code state. Affects the target. ATK ▼ 7.57% for 5 sec. DEF ▼ 7.57% for 5 sec.

skills.name: Secret Code
skills.summary: Lv1: ■ Activates when the last round of ammunition hits. Affects self. Collect Hacking Code: ATK ▲ 9.24%. Stacks up to 5 times and lasts for 15 sec.

skills.name: Partisan Protocol
skills.summary: Lv1: ■ Affects the 10 enemy unit(s) with the highest final DEF. Deals 67.27% of final ATK as damage. DEF ▼ 1.49% for 5 sec. ■ Activates when Collect Hacking Code is at max stacks. Affects the same target(s). Deals 67.27% of final ATK as additional damage.
